{{Top|leg}}
A '''moving sublight object''', or '''MSO''', was a term used to describe targets that could be acquired by [[Targeting sensor/Legends|targeting sensors]]. The [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]'s targeting sensors could track up to 1,000 MSOs and acquire 20 "bogeys" simultaneously, allowing the pilot to rapidly shift targets during combat.<ref name="SW RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
